card.name: "Other" or "another" before drug in interaction text
card.fires_on: The word "other" or "another" (also partway through "concomitant") right before "drug(s)" in drug-interaction sections, such as the heading "Effects of Other Drugs on X".

modes.label: Other/another before drug

modes.description: The middle of "concomitant" before medications or use in interaction text.
